experiment_data.hypothesis: MSE baseline re-training on SmolVLA Object for controlled comparison with loss variants
experiment_data.notes: Training completed cleanly (50/50 epochs, EXIT_CODE=0). Val loss decreased monotonically from 0.008373 (ep1) → 0.002080 (ep50), no overfitting/plateau visible — model still converging at end of cosine schedule. Train_loss=0.004038 vs val_loss=0.002080 (val < train, expected with augmentation noise on train side). Best ckpt saved at epoch 50. Loss values are NOT directly comparable across variants (perdof uses per-DoF weights, conformal_guided adds aux term to MSE); ablation conclusion requires downstream robot eval (success rate on Object task). Provides controlled reference for the 3 loss variants under identical hyperparameters/seed.
